subtasks: Place each tool into its matching position in the toolbox, then reset the robot arm.
Recover the wrench from the left edge of the toolbox and place it flat in its matching wrench recess.
Straighten the wrench in the narrow channel next to the hammer, with its silver head at the back and black handle flat toward the front.
Put the yellow tape measure into its matching broad recessed pocket at the back near the middle of the toolbox with the right gripper. Retract the left arm away from the toolbox.
Pick up the yellow and black pliers from the table at the right and place them flat in their matching recess in the right half of the toolbox, with the handles straddling the molded divider.
Pick up the displaced pliers inside the toolbox and reseat them flat in the right-hand recess, silver jaws toward the tape measure and handles straddling the small front divider.
Return both arms to their initial resting poses with both grippers fully open, keeping clear of the tools and toolbox.
